tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Page background: the beach every crab walks on.

tokens.name: sand-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, buttons, menus: anything that sits on the sand.

tokens.name: sand-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: input fields, the lane under a walking crab, code blocks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Quiet frames and dividers that carry no meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (text fields, secondary buttons, checkboxes): 3:1 on every sand surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on sand, sand-raised and sand-sunken. In light it is the crabs' own eye colour.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: phases, facts lines, section labels, hints. On any sand surface.

tokens.name: clawd
tokens.usage: Claude's crab. Primary fills (buttons, the done part of a bar), accent frames. Never as small text: use clawd-text.

tokens.name: clawd-light
tokens.usage: The highlight row: the top pixel row of a clawd fill and the work-in-progress stretch of a bar.

tokens.name: clawd-shade
tokens.usage: The shade row: the bottom pixel row of a clawd fill, and the crab's own shading.

tokens.name: clawd-text
tokens.usage: Clawd as text (titles, links, the band's flow title) on sand, sand-raised and clawd-soft.

tokens.name: clawd-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind clawd-text: the clawd chip, a selected row.

tokens.name: on-clawd
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a clawd fill (the primary button's label). Dark in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px inset frame inside the control's own border, so the frame reads 4px thick. An alias of ink.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, accepted, saved: as text on sand surfaces or success-soft. Always paired with a word (done) or the done crab.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind success text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Stopped, failed, invalid: as text on sand surfaces or danger-soft. Always paired with a word (stopped) or the failed crab.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs a look, over budget: as text on sand surfaces or warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warning text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral news, tips, planned: as text on sand surfaces or info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind info text.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The dashed ground line under a walking crab (2 on, 1 off, one art pixel high).

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The empty track of a pixel bar.

tokens.name: notch
tokens.usage: Task notches cut into a pixel bar between tasks.

tokens.name: glint
tokens.usage: The sparkle in a crab's eye and the glint that runs along a working bar.

tokens.name: crab-eye
tokens.usage: Every crab's eyes, in every theme.

families.label: "Silkscreen", "Pixelify Sans", ui-monospace, monospace
families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most: a hero or an empty screen's headline.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings, the flow title in a panel header.

styles.name: crab-name
styles.usage: A crab's name on its card or row.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, chips, tabs, field labels. Always uppercase.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each subagent shows up here as a crab of its own.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Counts and emphasis inside body text.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: The dim facts line, hints, timestamps. Facts are joined by a spaced middle dot.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Durations, costs and counts that line up; set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

spacing.note: A 4px grid on top of the 2px art pixel: a crab drawn at scale 2 lands on whole pixels.

tokens.name: pixel
tokens.usage: One art pixel at scale 2: borders, the notch, bar height steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a glyph and its label, inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps in a row (crab, title, phase), button padding block.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding block, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding inline, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections (Running, Planned, Done).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page regions.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero and empty-state breathing room.

radius.note: Nothing is rounded. Corners are notched one art pixel instead (see notch).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every surface and control. Use the notch tokens for the pixel-rounded look.

notch.note: The stepped corner cut, as on the pixel bar's ends: a clip-path removes a square of this size at each corner.

tokens.name: notch-1
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, fields, cards, panels: the default corner.

tokens.name: notch-2
tokens.usage: Large surfaces (speech bubbles, hero panels) where a 2px notch disappears.

tokens.name: border-1
tokens.usage: Every frame: panels, cards, fields, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: border-2
tokens.usage: A focused control (border plus the inset focus frame) and the active tab's bar.

shadow.note: Hard, offset, never blurred. Floating things use drop-shadow on a wrapper, since notched corners clip a box-shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: A clawd fill's highlight and shade rows (the primary button). Pressed: drop it and move 2px down.

tokens.name: shadow-press-neutral
tokens.usage: The shade row of a secondary button.

tokens.name: shadow-step
tokens.usage: Cards that lift a little. Use as filter: drop-shadow(var(--shadow-step)).

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Floating: speech bubbles, menus, toasts. As a drop-shadow on a wrapper.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus inside a notched control, together with border-color: var(--focus).
